evidence.supports: Tower at Lumber City in Telfair County at the listed coordinates, with no register codes listed

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms row supports this tower, so the story is well under the 120-word floor. Wikipedia's Lumber City article and the Telfair County GenWeb history were read and do not mention a tower. A Wikimedia Commons photo titled 'Georgia Forestry Commission Tower, Telfair County' (CC BY-SA 4.0, Michael Rivera, 2014) was checked and not used: its camera position, about 31.9529, -82.9334, is roughly 20 km west of this record's coordinates, so it may be a different tower. Status and access unknown. Confidence low.
